name: Sumit Gaur
title: Platform Lead | Distributed Systems | Cloud Infrastructure | Reliability & Platform Architecture
summary: Platform engineer with 10+ years designing and operating the distributed, event-driven infrastructure that other engineering teams depend on to ship reliably at scale. Owns systems end-to-end, from architecture through production operation, spanning cross-account cloud governance, asynchronous service infrastructure, identity and access control, and CI/CD platforms serving 100+ microservices in production. NVIDIA Certified Associate (NCA-AIIO), AWS Solutions Architect Professional, and CKA certified; currently leads a 3-engineer platform team.
